newsitem.title: USA: Mid-America to sell money order unit.
newsitem.headline: Mid-America to sell money order unit.

text.p: Mid-America Bancorp said Monday it entered into an agreement to sell its money order subsidiary to MoneyGram Payment Systems Inc for about $15 million in cash.
Mid-America Money Order Co is a provider of money orders and gift certificates through a nationwide network of agents, a news release issued by Mid-America said.
MoneyGram is a leading non-bank provider of consumer money transfer and other financial services, the news release said.
Mid-America Bancorp, through a new subsidiary, Mid-America Gift Certificate Co, will retain the gift certificate business of Mid-America Money Order Co, the news release said.

Mid-America Money Order Co and Mid-America Gift Certificate Co will continue to operate from its present location in Louisville, Ky., and existing employees are expected to be retained, the news release said.
The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1997, it said.
